title: Authorities complete 2026 review of payments Memorandum of Understanding
summary: The Bank of England (the Bank), Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and Payment Systems Regulator (PSR) have completed their annual review of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on payments. Read the MoU (PDF)Outcome of the review: The review found that cooperation and coordination between the Authorities – the Bank, FCA, PRA and PSR – has strengthened and remains effective.We concluded that no changes to the MoU are needed at this time.To complement the MoU, we have updated our information explaining how our objectives, regulatory remits and key workstreams fit together.The Authorities have considered the effectiveness and efficiency of their coordination under the MoU. This includes feedback from industry and regulated firms to determine whether the MoU’s principles of coordination and cooperation continue to be met in practice. The review found that cooperation and coordination remain effective, with respondents welcoming tangible progress in how the Authorities work together. Examples of this include collaborating on a range of developments, including the future regime for dual-regulated stablecoin issuers and other innovations in payments
